NAME
       geodb - Run the geodb command to display Diameter Geo Redundancy status.

MODULE
       util

SYNTAX
	run util diadb 
	Options:
	-h, --help
	-s, --status

DESCRIPTION
       The geodb utility allows users to displayDiameter Geo Redundancy status.

EXAMPLES
       run util geodb -s

       run util geodb --status

       Shows the Diameter Geo Redundancy status for the local BigIP.  The output displays the following status.

       connected
	    The system is active and connected to the peer site.

       offline
	    The system is active but not connected to the peer site.

       reload_receiving
	    The system is loading Diameter Persistence Records from the peer site.

       reload_sending
	    The system is sending Diameter Persistence Records to another peer site.

       unset
	    The system is starting and status has not been initialized.

       run util geodb -w

       run util geodb --watchdog

       Shows the Watchdog monitor status for the local BigIP.  The output displays the following status

       active
	    Watchdog monitor is active.

       expired
	    Watchdog monitor has expired.

       run util diadb -h

       run util diadb --help

       Shows geodb command syntax.

SEE ALSO
       run, tmsh
